answer: The wall is Staratlasmaker index strike attested before the comet record. Each brick is 7-year night-watch service, 158 supervised sightings, field exam, annual record dues, laid by a different hand, in a different year. Time is the tax: 16 minutes for one agent, 6064 minutes for 379 fakes, charged every epoch without fail. The vault arrives by post, the bridge arrives by bank transfer, and the pearl arrives by archive: none of them can be hurried. The farm's advantage was scale; this check turns scale into a bill.
